 By DNVR Sports via www.youtube.com, 10/20/2026 The 2026-27 Denver Nuggets season is here, and Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Aaron Gordon and the rest of Denver’s core enter the year with championship expectations and plenty to prove. We break down the Nuggets’ realistic ceiling, whether this could be Jokic’s best season yet, why Aaron Gordon may be the key to everything, and how David Adelman can put his stamp on the offense. Plus, we discuss Denver’s starting five, Christian Braun, Cam Johnson, the bench, defensive concerns and whether this could be the final run for this version of the Nuggets.
